question: Akash, Divya, Manish, Naresh, Paresh, Rohan, Somesh and Tanu are sitting round a circular table with nine seats. They all are facing away from centre. Divya sits fourth to the right of Manish. Somesh is an immediate neighbour of Divya and Naresh. Rohan sits second to the right of Divya. Akash is not an immediate neighbour of Manish and Divya. Tanu sits second to the left of Paresh. Who to the immediate left of Paresh?
solution:
**Eight persons:** Akash, Divya, Manish, Naresh, Paresh, Rohan, Somesh and Tanu with **nine seats.** This implies **one seat is vacant.**

1. They all are facing away from centre. 

2. Divya sits fourth to the right of Manish. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bc0ba496682ae66a25393546a14b6ab3d0b5048ff5774061958a48455450a7e.png] 

3. Somesh is an immediate neighbour of Divya and Naresh. 

4. Rohan sits second to the right of Divya.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c19827b3e785d0924ca0742c8604b1724a61c47a814c0f091554fb3c03618643.png] 

5. Akash is not an immediate neighbour of Manish and Divya. 

This implies that Akash will sit to the immediate right of Rohan.

6. Tanu sits second to the left of Paresh.

They both will be the neighbour of Manish.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5ce736780ab90caccddb7d034e2cdf5b2ca41ea690c7e3336fdae0e4e5b9f9c.png] 

Hence, Manish sits to the immediate left of Paresh.
